        {{:agencyIsABank}}
            {{isAdProfessional}}
                <p class="professional-name">
                    <span class="professional-name_type">
                        {{isAdRealEstateDeveloper}}
                            Promotora
                        {{:isAdRealEstateDeveloper}}
                            Profesional
                        {{/isAdRealEstateDeveloper}}
                    </span>

                    <span class="professional-name_name">
                        {{showProfessionalName}}
                            {{firstName}}
                                {{=firstName}} {{=lastName}}

                            {{:firstName}}
                                {{=commercialName}}
                                <input type="hidden" name="user-name" value="{{=commercialName}}" />
                            {{/firstName}}
                        {{:showProfessionalName}}
                            {{=commercialName}}
                            <input type="hidden" name="user-name" value="{{=commercialName}}" />
                        {{/showProfessionalName}}
                    </span>
                </p>
                <input type="hidden" name="professional"/>
                {{:isAdProfessional}}
                
                    <span class="icon-block"></span>
                
                <p class="txt-ref">
                    {{firstName}}
                        {{isInvoiceAd}}

                        {{:isInvoiceAd}}
                            Particular -
                        {{/isInvoiceAd}}
                        {{=firstName}}
                        <input type="hidden" name="user-name" value="{{=firstName}} {{=lastName}}" />
                    {{/firstName}}
                </p>
            {{/isAdProfessional}}
        {{/agencyIsABank}}

        <p class="ad-reference">
            <span class="name">Referencia del anuncio</span>
            <span class="ref-txt">{{=referenceMessage}}</span>
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="module-contact-gray about-container">
        
        {{showAboutAdvertiser}}
        <div class="advertiser-name-container">
            <a class="about-advertiser-name" href="{{=advertiserNameLink}}" title="{{=commercialName}}">
                {{=commercialName}}
            </a>
            <p class="advertiser-name-location">{{=micrositeCityName}}</p>
        </div>

        
        <div class="about-advertiser">
            {{mustShowLogo}}
            <div class="advertiser-logo">
                <a href="{{=advertiserNameLink}}">
                    <img src="{{=advertiserLogoUrl}}"
                         data-ondemand-img="{{=advertiserLogoUrl}}"
                         width="125"
                         height="60"
                         alt="{{=commercialName}}" />
                </a>
            </div>
            {{/mustShowLogo}}
        </div>
        {{/showAboutAdvertiser}}
    </div>
</script>
